text_block_list.text:
Marvelous Sunday gains experience with 
every race, steadily racking up both skill 
and fans.

However, that joy was short-lived; her 
body couldn't withstand her natural talent 
and overwhelming passion for running, 
leading to an injury.

However, Marvelous Sunday showed not even 
a hint of gloom. She managed to view even 
an injury in a positive light.

Encouraged by her positive attitude, they 
shifted their mindset, setting their 
sights on a strong Senior Year campaign 
and choosing the Challenge Cup as their 
next goal.
